mapper.insert: INSERT INTO w18_paid_professional_operation(operation_key,owner_member_id,request_id,command_hash,command_data,state,rejection_code,created_at,updated_at) VALUES(#{operationKey},#{ownerMemberId},#{requestId},#{commandHash},#{commandData},#{state},#{rejectionCode},#{createdAt},#{updatedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE operation_key=operation_key
mapper.select: SELECT operation_key AS operationKey,owner_member_id AS ownerMemberId,request_id AS requestId,command_hash AS commandHash, LENGTH(command_data) AS commandBytes,CASE WHEN LENGTH(command_data)<=4096 THEN command_data ELSE NULL END AS commandData, state,rejection_code AS rejectionCode,created_at AS createdAt,updated_at AS updatedAt FROM w18_paid_professional_operation WHERE operation_key=#{key} AND owner_member_id=#{actor} FOR UPDATE

SELECT operation_key AS operationKey,owner_member_id AS ownerMemberId,request_id AS requestId,command_hash AS commandHash, LENGTH(command_data) AS commandBytes,CASE WHEN LENGTH(command_data)<=4096 THEN command_data ELSE NULL END AS commandData, state,rejection_code AS rejectionCode,created_at AS createdAt,updated_at AS updatedAt FROM w18_paid_professional_operation WHERE owner_member_id=#{actor} AND operation_key < #{before} ORDER BY operation_key DESC LIMIT 51
mapper.update: UPDATE w18_paid_professional_operation SET state=#{state},rejection_code=#{reason},updated_at=#{at} WHERE operation_key=#{key} AND owner_member_id=#{actor} AND command_hash=#{hash} AND state='PREPARED'
